title: Uber Platform
html:
Real-time geospatial matching platform powering 100M+ rides. Key challenges: geospatial indexing, location ping ingestion, rider-driver matching, surge pricing.

Requirements

Functional

Drivers update location (every 4s) · Riders request ride · Match nearby drivers · Real-time location tracking · Surge pricing based on demand

Non-Functional

1M active drivers sending pings = 250k write QPS · Low matching latency (<2s) · High availability · Zero lost location pings during active trip

Geospatial Indexing: H3 / Quadtree

Uber uses Uber H3 (Hexagonal hierarchical spatial index). Hexagons are ideal for spatial analysis because all neighbor centroids are equidistant, eliminating edge distortion compared to rectangular grids.

System Architecture Flow

Driver App (WebSockets)
→
Location Ingestion Service
→
Kafka
→
Redis (H3 Spatial Index)
Rider Request
→
Dispatch Service
→
Geospatial Matcher
→
Driver Notification
